verdict.rationale: Ramp offers strong official building blocks for developers: a canonical OpenAPI spec with 174 paths (probed live), OAuth 2.0 with granular scopes, a sandbox environment, and an open-source agent-oriented CLI. However, nothing in the evidence shows first-party language SDK packages, so developers would need to hand-roll REST calls or generate clients from the OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official language SDK libraries (e.g. Python/TypeScript packages), SDK documentation or package-registry evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of building against an SDK.
